title: Fresh Corn Polenta Quiche
subtitle: with zucchini, okra and rocket topping
description: A buttery shortcrust case filled with a creamy fresh corn and parmesan polenta, baked until set and topped with quickly sauteed baby zucchini and okra.

steps.text: Process 200 g of the butter and the salt in a food processor. Add 1 egg and process until just combined. Add 300 g of the flour and process just until a dough forms. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 170°C. Roll the dough into a 5 mm thick sheet, press it gently into a tart tin, prick the base with a fork and refrigerate.
Heat the milk, water, salt, pepper and nutmeg in a heavy-based pot. Cut the kernels off the corn cobs, add them and cook for 15 to 20 minutes until tender.
Strain, keeping about 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Blend the kernels with the reserved liquid to a smooth puree and pass through a fine sieve.
Return the puree to the pot, add the cream and cook for about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, stir in the remaining 2 tbsp butter and the parmesan, then add half the chopped chilli.
Cool slightly, then mix in the remaining 2 eggs, beaten, and 2 tbsp flour. Pour into the cold pastry case and bake for about 30 minutes until set and golden.

Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a pan and sear the lengthways-sliced baby zucchini and okra over high heat for about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and toss with the rocket, remaining chilli and chopped tomatoes.
Top the quiche with the vegetables and serve.
